# CANDIDATE: ORATS_25D_SKEW_BULL_PULLBACK

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An extremely negative 0DTE 25‑delta put‑call IV skew (put IV − call IV < −0.04) indicates dealers are net short puts, creating a bullish dealer gamma bias that tends to pull SPY back toward VWAP after an early‑session deviation below VWAP. This edge exists because dealer hedging of short put positions generates delta‑neutral buying pressure when SPY declines, creating a mean‑reverting tendency toward VWAP that can be captured with a bullish entry structure.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Go long when (1) ORATS 0DTE 25‑delta skew (put IV − call IV) is below −0.04, (2) SPY price deviates more than 0.3% below VWAP, (3) the close of a bar crosses back above VWAP, (4) EMA ribbon is bullish (8‑period > 21‑period > 55‑period), and (5) volume exceeds 1.5× the 20‑bar average.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the prior swing low (structure), TP1 at 1R (risk‑reward 1:1), and a runner trailed at 20% off the high‑water mark. Trades are only taken after the first 15 minutes of the session and before the last 30 minutes, with VIX between 12 and 25, and avoided during FOMC and major expiry windows.

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account ~= 14% headline P&L scaling.
2. **Sample bias:** No historical backtest performed; proposal based on theoretical dealer gamma mechanics. High overfit risk due to untested signal parameters (skew threshold −0.04, VWAP deviation 0.3%, volume multiplier 1.5×).
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (no walk-forward or held-out window tested).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (no validation of OPRA fill quality on top 3 J days).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: whipsaw during low‑volume chop (e.g., VIX <12) causing repeated failed VWAP reclaims; max drawdown scenario: consecutive losses during high‑volatility expansion (VIX >25) where dealer gamma bias breaks down; blow‑up scenario: unexpected gap open against position during overnight news (e.g., CPI surprise) triggering stop at swing low.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to determine if top‑5 days drive X% of P&L.
